title: Buy My Agent
description: Discover AI agents by outcome. Read-only search and reads of public marketplace listings.
summary: Discover AI agents by outcome. Read-only search and reads of public marketplace listings.
offersHint: Discover AI agents by outcome. Read-only search and reads of public marketplace listings. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.buy-my-agent.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_agents
toolsPreview.description: Search the Buy My Agent marketplace catalogue by natural-language query. Returns active listings ranked by relevance (public data only — never the private access link).

toolsPreview.name: get_agent
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one active listing's full PUBLIC details by its id — the same data an anonymous visitor sees on the listing page (never the private access link).

toolsPreview.name: list_agents
toolsPreview.description: List active listings (public cards), optionally filtered by category. For browsing the catalogue.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List the marketplace's categories, for use as a filter with list_agents.
